import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import QPoint, QRect, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction, QIcon, QIconEngine, QPainter, QPixmap, QRegion
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout, QWidget
python.setup:
class GlyphEngine(QIconEngine):
    def __init__(self, glyph):
        super().__init__()
        self._glyph = glyph
    def clone(self):
        return GlyphEngine(self._glyph)
    def pixmap(self, size, mode, state):
        pm = QPixmap(size)
        pm.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
        renderer = fluentqt.FontIcon(self._glyph)
        renderer.setIconSize(min(size.width(), size.height()))
        renderer.setEnabled(mode != QIcon.Mode.Disabled)
        renderer.resize(size)
        painter = QPainter(pm)
        renderer.render(painter, QPoint(), QRegion(), QWidget.RenderFlag.DrawChildren)
        painter.end()
        return pm
    def paint(self, painter, rect, mode, state):
        dpr = max(1, round(painter.device().devicePixelRatioF())) if painter.device() else 1
        painter.drawPixmap(rect, self.pixmap(rect.size() * dpr, mode, state))

root_layout = QVBoxLayout(%PARENT%)
root_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
card = fluentqt.Card(%PARENT%)
card.setAppearance(fluentqt.Card.Appearance.LayerAlt)
root_layout.addWidget(card)
card_layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
card_layout.setContentsMargins(12, 10, 12, 12)
card_layout.setSpacing(8)
control = fluentqt.SelectorBar(card)
page_host = fluentqt.StackContentHost(card)
page_host.setTransitionAnimationEnabled(False)
specs = [
    ("Inbox", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Mail, "Unread messages, mentions, and prioritized threads."),
    ("Calendar", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Calendar, "Upcoming design reviews and release syncs."),
    ("Tasks", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.List, "Open action items assigned to this milestone."),
    ("Contacts", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Contact, "Contributors and external collaborators."),
    ("Documents", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Document, "Shared specifications, specs, and notes."),
    ("Flagged", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Flag, "Starred discussions requiring follow-up."),
    ("Settings", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Settings, "Sync interval and section visibility rules."),
]
for i, (title, glyph, summary) in enumerate(specs):
    control.addItem(fluentqt.SelectorBarItem(title, glyph))
    page = fluentqt.Card(page_host)
    page_layout = QVBoxLayout(page)
    page_layout.setContentsMargins(14, 12, 14, 12)
    page_layout.setSpacing(4)
    heading = fluentqt.Label(title, page)
    heading.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
    body = fluentqt.Label(summary, page)
    body.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
    body.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
    body.setWordWrap(True)
    page_layout.addWidget(heading)
    page_layout.addWidget(body)
    page_layout.addStretch(1)
    page_host.insertPage(i, page)
control.setSelectedIndex(0)
page_host.setCurrentIndex(0, 0, False)
overflow_menu = fluentqt.FluentMenu("Overflow", control)
control.currentChanged.connect(lambda index: page_host.setCurrentIndex(index, 0, False) if 0 <= index < page_host.count() else None)
def show_overflow(hidden_indexes):
    if not hidden_indexes:
        return
    overflow_menu.clear()
    for index in hidden_indexes:
        item = control.itemAt(index)
        action = overflow_menu.addAction(item.text)
        if item.iconGlyph:
            action.setIcon(QIcon(GlyphEngine(item.iconGlyph)))
        action.triggered.connect(lambda checked=False, target=index: control.setSelectedIndex(target))
    anchor = control.overflowGeometry()
    overflow_menu.popup(control.mapToGlobal(anchor.bottomLeft() if anchor.isValid() else QPoint(0, control.height())))
control.overflowActivated.connect(show_overflow)
card_layout.addWidget(control)
card_layout.addWidget(page_host, 1)
